Two skills in one session because both changes answer the same observation with the same check; the MANUAL_STEPS.md item they cite was confirmed present

reason: Both RAG skills, unchanged since 2026-08-11 and 2026-08-10, verified Docker Model Runner only by sending requests, and a working request path hid a broken update path for weeks: the llama.cpp CUDA backend's installer kept failing on a missing nv-gpu-info helper while the stale build went on serving (observation 80; the fix is documented in MANUAL_STEPS.md since 2026-10-12). The 2026-10-14 review staged the same status check for both skills; installing them makes docker model status and the CUDA0 log line part of their checks.
rollback: git revert restores the previous skill text. The staged source copy stays outside the repository at ~/.claude/skill-updates/2026-10-14/rag-change and ~/.claude/skill-updates/2026-10-14/rag-knowledge and is not touched by a revert
security_impact: None - agent-facing skill text only; no runtime code, configuration, or permission changes
